rci5_n.detail: Training phase; VAE pretrained on 198 healthy adults from TractoInferno (6 studies), then fine-tuned separately on CN training splits from each cohort. CN split was 35%/15%/50% for training/validation/testing. ADNI total CN=447, test=226 (stated), so training+val=221, training≈156 (35% of 447). NIMHANS total CN=123, test=62 (stated), so training+val=61, training≈43 (35% of 123). Exact training N not explicitly reported; inferred from stated split percentages.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "data from the CN participants were split into independent subsets of size 35%/15%/50% for training/validation/testing" "The test set contained a large percentage of CN subjects - 226 subjects from ADNI and 62 from NIMHANS" "this pretraining dataset consisted of 198 single-shell dMRI volumes already preprocessed from the publicly available TractoInferno training dataset, 38 acquired on 3T scanners with b-values around 1000 s/mm2 from six studies." "The pretrained VAE model was fine-tuned on 30 bundles from the subjects in the training set, in each cohort, for 5000 steps. We did not pool the training data in ADNI and NIMHANS together in this step"
